_doc: Owners and witnesses (spells-and-environment spec §7.3, §9; build item N-4.4). values: what each prop kind is worth in crowns. owners: who a thing belongs to and whether they mend it (`repairs`). maps: each map's `default` owner and owners by place (`places`, a place id from the map's places); "" is nobody's (wild or abandoned: nothing is owed and nothing repairs, so the halls remember you for the life). repair_days: how many dawns after it was broken or burned an owner has it put back. sight: how far (px) someone sees a change, by day and at dusk and night. ladder: what a witnessed change costs by value: under `complain_under` crowns a grumble, up to `guards_over` the owner wants paying (counted in Run.life "owed" until there's money), over that the watch is called; `standing` is what each step costs with the owner, and `fire` counts a prop set burning as the top step's cost when it isn't the top step already. Unwitnessed damage is found by the next person to see it: `found` standing and a point of suspicion. Good deeds: putting out an owned prop's fire, or mending one with Time, `good` standing and a point of fame.

complain: Who's going to clean that up?
demand: You'll pay for that. %d crowns, to %s.
found: Burned... and only one caster in this camp.
